text: {"lessons":["My account has moved through both declines and gains, so I should judge decisions over time rather than react to a single month.","I bought several stocks and later sold Stock A at a gain, but one profitable sale does not prove a strategy will keep working; I should make trades based on a plan, not recent price moves.","I should review my overall allocation and keep enough cash for my goals, while continuing regular saving toward an apartment instead of pursuing quick gains."]}
